candidates.statement: Gateway checkout POSTs return 502 after ~2s because the gateway's client call to order (/v1/orders) fails with transport errors at ~2s, indicating order-side latency/timeout rather than gateway failure.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side logs/metrics absent; cannot confirm whether order is slow, unreachable, or timing out on its own dependencies (inventory, payment, postgresql).

report.explanation: Gateway logs show repeated 502s on /v1/checkout paired with transport errors calling order at ~2s, while /readyz stays 200 and checkout p95 is ~2425ms. This localizes the fault downstream of the gateway at the order hop, consistent with downstream-latency, but order-side telemetry is missing to confirm the mechanism.
missing_evidence: Order service logs and metrics for /v1/orders latency and error rates during the incident window
Order-to-dependency (inventory, payment, postgresql) latency/error telemetry to localize the ~2s stall
Gateway client timeout configuration to confirm the ~2s cutoff is a timeout threshold
